verdict.rationale: The evidence shows one unified CLI that controls multiple AWS services and surfaces documentation inline (aws-docs-1, aws-docs-42, aws-docs-4). It also shows a docs hub covering many services, an llms.txt index of per-service documentation including non-flagship ones like Resource Groups, and an API Reference for a secondary service (Cost Explorer). However, nothing directly documents that every service has a consistent API/CLI reference, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of complete, uniform per-service API and CLI reference coverage across the whole catalog; independent or hands-on corroboration of reference consistency; a published machine-readable API spec.
